map.基于OLGIM分期系统，评估胃黏膜肠化生的萎缩范围及胃癌风险分层: Based on the OLGIM staging system, assess the extent of gastric mucosal intestinal metaplasia and stratify gastric cancer risk.
map.胃肠化生 OLGIM 分期：按胃窦与胃体 IM 分级经矩阵查表定 0 至 IV: Gastric intestinal metaplasia OLGIM staging: determine stage 0 to IV from antral and body IM grades via a matrix lookup; OLGA is based on atrophy grading; stages III–IV are high risk requiring endoscopic follow-up.
map.OLGIM基于肠化生程度，比OLGA（基于萎缩程度）重复性更好。两者分期矩阵结构: OLGIM is based on the degree of intestinal metaplasia and has better reproducibility than OLGA (which is based on atrophy degree). Both share the same staging matrix structure.
map.：无IM，胃癌风险极低，无需特殊随访: : no IM, gastric cancer risk extremely low, no special follow-up needed
map.：低风险，每3年随访胃镜: : low risk, follow-up gastroscopy every 3 years
map.：中风险，建议每1-2年随访胃镜: : moderate risk, gastroscopy every 1-2 years recommended
map.：高风险（全胃IM），建议每年随访胃镜: : high risk (whole-stomach IM), annual gastroscopy recommended
map.提示：OLGIM分期需基于规范的5点活检（胃窦小弯、胃窦大弯、胃角、胃体小弯、胃: Note: OLGIM staging must be based on standard 5-point biopsy (antral lesser curvature, antral greater curvature, angle, body lesser curvature, body greater curvature). H. pylori positive patients should undergo eradication first. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：肠化生（萎缩）OLGIM/OLGA 分期与胃癌风险: 📚 Deep Dive: Intestinal Metaplasia (Atrophy) OLGIM/OLGA Staging and Gastric Cancer Risk
map.萎缩分期：由胃窦/胃体肠化生与萎缩范围定 OLGIM 分期: Atrophy staging: determine OLGIM stage from antral/body intestinal metaplasia and atrophy extent
map.风险分层：III-IV 期胃癌风险显著升高，加强随访: Risk stratification: gastric cancer risk rises markedly at stages III-IV, strengthening follow-up
map.随访决策：按分期定胃镜复查间隔（3 年/1~2 年/每年）: Follow-up decision: set gastroscopy intervals by stage (3 years / 1~2 years / annually)
map.算法：OLGIM 矩阵 = [[0,1,1,2],[1,1,2,2],[1,2,: Algorithm: OLGIM matrix = [[0,1,1,2],[1,1,2,2],[1,2,2,3],[2,2,3,3]] (rows = antral IM 0~3, columns = body IM 0~3); the homologous OLGA matrix follows atrophy extent. Stage 0 extremely low risk, I low (3 years), II moderate (1~2 years), III-IV high (annually); H. pylori eradication is advised in all cases.
map.例：胃窦肠化生 2 度、胃体肠化生 3 度 → OLGIM[2][3] = 3: Example: antral IM grade 2, body IM grade 3 → OLGIM[2][3] = stage III, high risk; annual gastroscopy plus biopsy after H. pylori eradication is advised. If antrum and body both show no IM or atrophy (0,0) → OLGIM[0][0] = stage 0, extremely low risk, needing only health maintenance follow-up and H. pylori eradication (if positive).
map.OLGIM 和 OLGA 有什么区别？: What is the difference between OLGIM and OLGA?
map.OLGIM 基于肠化生范围、OLGA 基于萎缩范围，二者分期矩阵结构相同。临床常: OLGIM is based on metaplasia extent and OLGA on atrophy extent; both share the same staging matrix structure. Clinically they are often combined: OLGA more sensitively reflects atrophy, while OLGIM relates more directly to gastric cancer risk, with stages III-IV marking high risk.
map.轻度肠化生根除 Hp 后可部分消退，但中重度多不可逆。重点不是逆转而是监测——高: Mild intestinal metaplasia can partly regress after H. pylori eradication, but moderate-to-severe is mostly irreversible. The point is not reversal but surveillance — high-risk stages need periodic gastroscopy plus biopsy to detect dysplasia and early cancer in time.
map.关于「肠化生萎缩范围评估器」: About the Intestinal Metaplasia Atrophy Extent Assessor
map.肠化生(萎缩范围)评估器，基于OLGIM和OLGA分期系统，根据胃窦和胃体活检的: The Intestinal Metaplasia (atrophy extent) assessor, based on the OLGIM and OLGA staging systems, stratifies gastric cancer risk from the degree of atrophy and intestinal metaplasia in antral and body biopsies. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
